upstream_augmentations: Bounding-box 90-degree clockwise, counter-clockwise and upside-down rotation
local_correspondence: Version counts, classes, dimensions and 12 train / 4 validation-test derivatives per DJI filename family agree with local files. User identified this source. Full upstream export checksums unavailable.
independence: DJI_0185 filename family appears in train and test; all 12 training derivatives conservatively excluded. Filenames infer source identity but flights/scenes and global uniqueness of DJI names are unverified.
processing_order: Roboflow lists tiling as preprocessing and augmentation only for training. Local derivatives are already exported; exact source-frame assignment chronology not recoverable from files. Grouped CV uses complete exported families, never tile-level random splitting.
claims: This is a public reused dataset, not a proprietary dataset acquired by the paper authors. 1000 exported tiles/augmentations are not 1000 independent source frames. No flight, camera, altitude or annotation-consensus metadata should be invented.
